rows.evidence: Q1: Sections 2.2-2.3 and 3 - the authors collected their own soil EC1:5 samples (50 and 33 points, May and June 2022) and flew their own UAV hyperspectral campaign over a 5.34 ha cotton field in Wujiaqu, Xinjiang. Q2: Section 3.6 and Table 4 - the PSO-GPR model built on 0.7-order FOD bands selected with BOSS plus 2D/3D indices reached a test-set R2 of 0.9201, RMSE of 0.1535 dS m-1 and RPD of 3.54, and was used to map surface (0-10 cm) salinity at emergence and squaring periods (Section 3.7, Fig. 11). Q4: Sections 3.2 and 3.4, Figs. 7-8 - the study measures the spectral pathway by which the method senses salinity: it describes salinity-related differences in soil and canopy reflectance (chlorophyll absorption at 444-510 and 565-675 nm, moisture-related valleys at 928 nm) and reports Pearson correlations of 1D bands and 2D/3D indices with measured EC (e.g. TBI6 r = 0.82 at 0.7 order). Q8: Section 4.4 - the authors state that the limited size of the study area prevented inclusion of environmental factors such as parent material and regional salinity composition, that only 400-1000 nm UAV data were used (no NIR/SWIR), that ground spectra and satellite data were not integrated, and that cover materials and multicollinearity may reduce accuracy.
rows.notes: The study supports the monitoring/prediction accuracy part of the passage (R2 0.92, RMSE 0.15 dS m-1 are its own test-set figures). It does not test irrigation management or salinization mitigation; the statement that the maps support scientific irrigation and salinity management is an assertion in the abstract and conclusion, not a tested result, so the 'reinforcing irrigation management and salinization mitigation' clause is unsupported. Q3: validation is a single approach (regression prediction versus laboratory EC1:5), no independent second method such as EM38 or ground spectra (the authors note these were not integrated). Q5: one field, one crop, one region, two growth stages. Q6: 5.34 ha single field only; larger-scale application is listed as future work. Q7: the only condition stated from own findings is a modelling parameter (FOD order below 1.0 gives better accuracy), which is a processing choice rather than a condition for the monitoring effect; no biophysical or institutional requirement stated. Q9: only RMSE/R2/RPD are reported; the 20 training repeats are not summarised with dispersion, and the SD reported in Fig. 4 describes the sampled EC, not the prediction result.

notes: Full text available; figures are referenced but not reproduced. The R2 of 0.93/0.92 in the conclusion refers to training/test sets, consistent with Table 4.
